sql.if: and exists ( select 1 from sys_user_role ur inner join sys_role r on r.role_id=ur.role_id and r.status='0' where ur.user_id=#{currentUserId} and ( #{permissions} is null or #{permissions} = '' or exists ( select 1 from sys_role_menu rm inner join sys_menu m on m.menu_id = rm.menu_id where rm.role_id = r.role_id and m.status = '0' and m.perms is not null and m.perms != '' and find_in_set(m.perms, #{permissions}) > 0 ) ) and ( r.data_scope='1' or (r.data_scope='2' and c.dept_id in (select dept_id from sys_role_dept where role_id=r.role_id)) or (r.data_scope='3' and c.dept_id=#{currentDeptId}) or (r.data_scope='4' and c.dept_id in (select sd.dept_id from sys_dept sd where sd.dept_id=#{currentDeptId} or find_in_set(#{currentDeptId}, sd.ancestors))) or (r.data_scope='5' and (c.owner_id=#{currentUserId} or c.main_lawyer_id=#{currentUserId} or find_in_set(#{currentUserId}, ifnull(c.assistant_lawyer_ids,'')))) ) )

mapper.sql: select c.*, u.nick_name ownerName, d.dept_name deptName, ct.contract_name contractName, ct.sign_amount contractSignAmount, (select coalesce(sum(p.receivable_amount),0) from biz_contract_fee_plan p where p.contract_id=c.contract_id) contractReceivableAmount, (select coalesce(sum(p.received_amount),0) from biz_contract_fee_plan p where p.contract_id=c.contract_id and p.confirm_status='1') contractReceivedAmount, (select count(1) from biz_case_node n inner join biz_case_node_material m on m.node_id=n.node_id where n.case_id=c.case_id and n.del_flag='0') nodeMaterialTotal, (select count(1) from biz_case_node n inner join biz_case_node_material m on m.node_id=n.node_id where n.case_id=c.case_id and n.del_flag='0' and m.material_status='ready') nodeMaterialReady, (select count(1) from biz_case_archive a inner join biz_case_archive_material m on m.archive_id=a.archive_id where a.case_id=c.case_id) archiveMaterialTotal, (select count(1) from biz_case_archive a inner join biz_case_archive_material m on m.archive_id=a.archive_id where a.case_id=c.case_id and m.material_status='ready') archiveMaterialReady from biz_case c left join biz_contract ct on ct.contract_id=c.contract_id and ct.del_flag='0' left join sys_user u on u.user_id=c.owner_id left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id=c.dept_id
mapper.select: select 'active' metricKey,count(*) metricValue from biz_case c where c.del_flag='0' and c.case_status in ('processing','closing','closed') union all select 'todayProgress',count(*) from biz_case_progress p left join biz_case c on c.case_id=p.case_id where p.del_flag='0' and c.del_flag='0' and date(p.create_time)=curdate() union all select 'dueNodes',count(*) from biz_case_node n left join biz_case c on c.case_id=n.case_id where n.del_flag='0' and c.del_flag='0' and n.node_status in ('pending','current') and n.plan_date between curdate() and date_add(curdate(), interval 7 day) union all select 'closing',count(*) from biz_case c where c.del_flag='0' and c.case_status='closing' union all select 'monthArchived',count(*) from biz_case c where c.del_flag='0' and c.case_status='archived' and date_format(c.update_time,'%Y%m')=date_format(sysdate(),'%Y%m')

select c.case_type itemName,count(*) itemValue from biz_case c where c.del_flag='0'
group by c.case_type order by itemValue desc

select 'dueNodes' metricKey,count(*) metricValue from biz_case_node n left join biz_case c on c.case_id=n.case_id where n.del_flag='0' and c.del_flag='0' and n.node_status in ('pending','current') and n.plan_date between curdate() and date_add(curdate(), interval 7 day) union all select 'missingMaterial',count(*) from biz_case_node_material m left join biz_case_node n on n.node_id=m.node_id left join biz_case c on c.case_id=n.case_id where n.del_flag='0' and c.del_flag='0' and m.material_status!='ready' union all select 'closing',count(*) from biz_case c where c.del_flag='0' and c.case_status='closing' union all select 'staleProgress',count(*) from biz_case c where c.del_flag='0' and c.case_status='processing' and (c.last_progress_time is null or c.last_progress_time < date_sub(sysdate(), interval 7 day))
where c.case_id=#{caseId} and c.del_flag='0'
select * from biz_case where contract_id=#{contractId} and del_flag='0' limit 1
mapper.update:
update biz_case
case_name=#{caseName}, case_type=#{caseType}, urgency=#{urgency}, priority=#{priority}, risk_level=#{riskLevel}, case_stage=#{caseStage}, fee_status=#{feeStatus}, archive_status=#{archiveStatus}, cause=#{cause}, dispute_amount=#{disputeAmount}, court_name=#{courtName}, case_filing_no=#{caseFilingNo}, case_summary=#{caseSummary}, recent_progress=#{recentProgress}, last_progress_time=sysdate(), current_node=#{currentNode}, next_key_date=(select min(n.plan_date) from biz_case_node n where n.case_id=#{caseId} and n.del_flag='0' and n.node_status in ('pending','current')) , update_by=#{updateBy}, update_time=sysdate()
where case_id=#{caseId} and del_flag='0'
mapper.select: select count(1) from biz_case c where c.case_id=#{caseId} and c.del_flag='0'
select count(1) from biz_case_node where case_id=#{caseId} and del_flag='0' and node_status in ('pending','current','overdue')

select node_id,node_name,node_type,node_status,plan_date from biz_case_node where case_id=#{caseId} and del_flag='0' and node_status in ('current','overdue','pending') order by case node_status when 'current' then 1 when 'overdue' then 2 else 3 end, plan_date asc, node_id asc limit 1
select count(1) from biz_case_expense where case_id=#{caseId} and del_flag='0'
select count(1) from biz_case_expense where case_id=#{caseId} and del_flag='0' and ifnull(pay_status, 'pending') != 'paid'
select * from biz_case_field_value where case_id=#{caseId} order by order_num asc, field_id asc
select * from biz_case_field_config where case_type=#{caseType} and status='0' order by order_num asc, config_id asc

select p.*, c.case_no caseNo,c.case_name caseName,c.customer_name customerName,c.case_status caseStatus from biz_case_progress p left join biz_case c on c.case_id=p.case_id
and p.del_flag='0' and c.del_flag='0' and p.case_id=#{caseId} and (c.case_no like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or c.case_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or p.content like concat('%',#{keyword},'%'))
order by p.record_time desc,p.progress_id desc
select * from biz_case_progress where progress_id=#{progressId}
mapper.update: update biz_case_progress set record_time=#{recordTime},content=#{content},next_plan=#{nextPlan},sync_customer=#{syncCustomer},attachment_url=#{attachmentUrl},attachment_name=#{attachmentName},update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=sysdate() where progress_id=#{progressId} and del_flag='0'
update biz_case_progress set del_flag='2',update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=sysdate() where progress_id=#{progressId} and del_flag='0'
mapper.select: select * from biz_case_node where node_id=#{nodeId}
mapper.update: update biz_case_node set node_name=#{nodeName},node_type=#{nodeType},node_status=#{nodeStatus},plan_date=#{planDate},actual_date=#{actualDate},court_place=#{courtPlace},court_room=#{courtRoom},owner_id=#{ownerId},owner_name=#{ownerName},remind_time=#{remindTime},remind_targets=#{remindTargets},remark=#{remark},update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=sysdate() where node_id=#{nodeId} and del_flag='0'
update biz_case_node set del_flag='2',update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=sysdate() where node_id=#{nodeId} and del_flag='0'
mapper.select: select * from biz_case_node_material where node_id=#{nodeId} order by material_id asc
select * from biz_case_expense where expense_id=#{expenseId}
mapper.update: update biz_case_expense set expense_type=#{expenseType},amount=#{amount},occur_date=#{occurDate},pay_status=#{payStatus},reimburse_status=#{reimburseStatus},voucher_status=#{voucherStatus},handler_id=#{handlerId},handler_name=#{handlerName},voucher_url=#{voucherUrl},voucher_name=#{voucherName},remark=#{remark},update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=sysdate() where expense_id=#{expenseId} and del_flag='0'
update biz_case_expense set del_flag='2',update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=sysdate() where expense_id=#{expenseId} and del_flag='0'

select d.*, c.case_no caseNo,c.case_name caseName,c.customer_name customerName,c.case_status caseStatus from biz_case_document d left join biz_case c on c.case_id=d.case_id
and d.del_flag='0' and c.del_flag='0' and d.case_id=#{caseId} and d.document_type=#{documentType} and (c.case_no like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or c.case_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or c.customer_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or d.file_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%'))
order by d.create_time desc,d.document_id desc
select * from biz_case_document where document_id=#{documentId}
mapper.update: update biz_case_document set del_flag='2',update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=sysdate() where document_id=#{documentId} and del_flag='0'
mapper.select: select * from biz_case_archive where case_id=#{caseId} limit 1
select * from biz_case_archive_material where archive_id=#{archiveId} order by material_id asc
select count(1) from biz_case_archive_material where archive_id=#{archiveId}
select count(1) from biz_case_archive_material where archive_id=#{archiveId} and material_status != 'ready'
